node.statement: Unconditional assembly of the explicit Stage-1 raw call. Use the target geometry and corner bounds proved in node 1.2 by lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope, the three producer applications proved in node 1.3 by lem-stage1-rectified-nontrivial-projection, lem-stage1-original-complementary-pair, and lem-stage1-fresh-two-point-inclusion, and the literal old-side compression proved in node 1.4 by lem-compcb-single-compression-transfer. With the unconditional ledger of the preceding child, every projection, complementarity, producer-map, old-map, and target-ambient defect is at most t_1<=e_1. Before invoking lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement, record the complete def-maincb-raw-call datum: Stage-1 tag; supplied input w; source C^{m+1}; base scale t_1 and no post-helper scale; complementary target pieces P_old,P_fresh; for m>1 target A and the literal sum of v_old and v_fresh through their corner-to-A inclusions with the summed fixed amplifications, target-ambient defect epsilon, and candidate d_raw:=D_1*t_1; for m=1 target A_fresh=S_{P_fresh}, v_raw:=v_fresh with its fixed amplifications, target-ambient defect L*epsilon, and candidate d_raw:=C_pair*L*epsilon. By def-maincb-raw-call, recording d_raw asserts no estimate and is noncircular. Now lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement applies: for m>1 it certifies the sum as an extended D_1*t_1-inclusion C^{m+1}->A, while for m=1 it returns the supplied fresh inclusion. Hence the recorded datum satisfies that external at base scale t_1=K_1*epsilon, proving the root without any extra hypothesis.
